13:05.race_name: Conference & Events At Carlisle Racecourse Novices' Hurdle (Go North Night Nurse Series Qual') (GBB)

runners.comment: Easy win on yard debut at Exeter last month and that form reads very well; leading claims
runners.name: Johnnys Jury
runners.owner: Blazing Blues Rc Hurlers On The Ditch
runners.spotlight: Promising third over hurdles at Ffos Las (2m4f, soft) last January on sole run for Nicky Henderson and won comfortably on last month's yard debut at Exeter (2m, good to soft), forms that reads very well; leading claims.

runners.comment: Had some solid yardsticks in behind when winning on hurdle debut at Ayr; respected
runners.name: Kilnesare Flight
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in a point and a bumper (both on soft ground) before winning on hurdle debut at Ayr (2m, heavy) last month; he had some solid yardsticks in behind and is open to further improvement; respected.

runners.breeder: Haras De Saint Voir Sca & Mr Joel Denis
runners.comment: In good form in handicaps this season; major player now back down in trip
runners.name: Knomorediamonds
runners.spotlight: In good form in handicaps this season, winning easily at Hexham (2m4f, good to soft) in October and running well in defeat at Haydock (2m3f/2m5f, good to soft) on his last two starts; also effective on soft; has been shaping as though this drop back in trip could suit; major player.

runners.comment: Point/bumper winner but pulled up/tailed off this year on first two hurdle starts
runners.name: Coco Masterpiece
runners.spotlight: Very lightly raced 9yo who has won a point and a bumper; one to watch in the betting but he's been pulled up/tailed off this year on his first two hurdle starts, following a long absence.

runners.comment: 2-2 prior to promising run on C&D hurdle debut (final-flight faller); could be involved
runners.name: Matching Energy
runners.spotlight: Won point-to-point bumper last April (2m, good) and made it 2-2 in bumper at Hexham (2m, good to soft) in June; he was the only one to give the heavily odds-on favourite any sort of a race when falling at the final flight over C&D (soft) on hurdle debut; could be involved.

runners.comment: Point winner but well beaten on bumper debut and needs a big step forward today
runners.name: McElhattan
runners.spotlight: Won Irish maiden point (3m, soft to heavy) in November on second start; should be capable of better than he showed on bumper debut at Ayr (2m, heavy) last month but was well beaten and needs a big step forward today.

runners.comment: Tailed off at 16-1 on debut in Haydock bumper in 2022 and absent since
runners.name: The Foreman
runners.spotlight: Half-brother to winners Copper Fox (2m hurdle; RPR 106) and Golden Chancer (3m/3m3f hurdle; 103); tailed off at 16-1 on debut in Haydock bumper (1m7f, good to soft) in 2022 and absent since; a watching brief is advised.

runners.comment: Useful pedigree but tailed off at big odds in both bumpers; a transformation is necessary
runners.name: Khaleesi Queen
runners.spotlight: Useful pedigree but tailed off at big odds in both bumpers; a transformation is necessary on hurdle debut.

runners.comment: Won on debut in Irish mares' maiden point last March but tailed off on both hurdle starts
runners.name: Nevershedatear
runners.spotlight: Won on debut in Irish mares' maiden point (3m, yielding) last March but tailed off on first two hurdle starts (2m3f/2m1f, soft/good to soft); needs to be an entirely different proposition now in a tongue-tie.

runners.comment: 0-6 on the Flat and well beaten at 33-1 on hurdle/stable debut at Musselburgh
runners.name: Blondina
runners.spotlight: 0-6 on the Flat and didn't achieve much; well beaten at 33-1 on hurdle/stable debut at Musselburgh (1m7f, good to soft) and others are preferred.

runners.comment: 8l second to progressive winner at Doncaster last time and he's one to consider
runners.name: Grain dOudairies
runners.spotlight: Two wins towards the end of last year (2m1f/2m4f, good to soft) and 8l second to progressive winner at Doncaster (2m, soft) last time; he can give another good account and is one to consider.

runners.comment: Went close at Doncaster in November and he was in a hot race when tailed off last time
runners.name: Here Comes Georgie
runners.spotlight: Unproven on soft ground and tailed off at Ascot last time, although that was in a hot Class 2; went close in Class 3 at Doncaster (2m3f, good to soft) two starts ago and not ruled out now back down in grade.

runners.comment: Returning from long absence when pulled up at 25-1 at Haydock on Saturday; best watched
runners.name: Twoshotsoftequila
runners.spotlight: Won two in a row in early 2024 but he was having his first run since when pulled up at 25-1 at Haydock on Saturday; best watched.

runners.comment: Respectable fourth last month when back chasing; has run well on both previous visits here
runners.name: Hardy Du Seuil
runners.spotlight: Won over hurdles at Windsor (2m, good to soft) in November and respectable fourth at Haydock (2m, good to soft) last month on first chase start since March 2024; has run well on both visits here; might not be far away.

runners.comment: Defied 628-day layoff for chase debut win at Ayr in 2023; back from 789 days off this time
runners.name: Soft Risk
runners.spotlight: Absent since winning three-runner handicap on chase debut at Ayr (2m, soft) in December 2023; however, that came after a 628-day layoff and no surprise if he runs another big race back from 789 days off this time.

runners.breeder: Philippe Thiriet & S C E A Haras De Pey
runners.comment: Underwhelming at Down Royal last time but good second on chase debut at Ayr previously
runners.name: Karafon
runners.spotlight: Underwhelming at Down Royal last time when cheekpieces were applied (now left off); however, prior to that he ran well in second at Ayr (2m4f, soft) on his second chase start and has a part to play if rediscovering that form.

runners.comment: Something to prove regarding current form but 5-10 at Carlisle; not ruled out back here
runners.name: Hello Judge
runners.spotlight: Won here (2m4f, good) in October and followed up at Hexham (2m4f, good to soft); below par at Newcastle and Wetherby since and arrives with something to prove, but he's back on his last winning mark and ten visits to Carlisle have yielded five wins (various ground); not ruled out now back here.

runners.breeder: Mme Clarence Signol & Mr Xavier Brelaud
runners.comment: Regressive profile but step back in right direction last time and mark continues to fall
runners.name: Netywell
runners.spotlight: 9yo who has a regressive profile and his losing sequence is up to 11, but he took a step back in the right direction when fourth at Ayr (2m, soft) last month and continues to drop down the weights; each-way claims.

runners.comment: Close third at Doncaster in December but soundly beaten when upped to this grade last time
runners.name: Willie Shake Hands
runners.spotlight: Won on chase debut at Hexham (1m7f, good) last May and close third of six at Doncaster (2m, good to soft) in December; however, beaten 20l in fifth when upped in grade at Haydock (2m, good to soft) last month and remains in Class 3 company today; a career-best is required.

14:05.race_name: Come Racing At Carlisle In 2026 Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Triple-figure odds when tailed off over hurdles on his first two starts
runners.name: Cool Master
runners.spotlight: There's some potential in his pedigree but he was triple-figure odds when tailed off over hurdles on his first two starts.

runners.comment: Has shown some ability but not enough to suggest he'll make an impact today
runners.name: Eagles Cairn
runners.spotlight: Half-brother to 2m7f/3m1f hurdle winner Miss Fairfax (RPR 125); has shown some ability but not enough to suggest he'll make an impact today.

runners.comment: Runner-up in Musselburgh bumper and open to improvement now up in trip on hurdle debut
runners.name: Forever Louie
runners.spotlight: Kept on for 4l second of seven at Musselburgh (1m7f, good to soft) in December and this half-brother to useful 2m4f-2m7f hurdle winner Ryedale Racer is open to improvement now up in trip over hurdles; each-way chance.

runners.comment: The step up in trip may help on this second hurdle start but others are still preferred
runners.name: Good Boy Griff
runners.spotlight: Unable to threaten in his three bumpers and same story when 28-1 for recent hurdle debut at Southwell (2m, good to soft); made the frame in a 3m point and the step up in trip may help, but others are still preferred.

runners.comment: 2nd at Auteuil in November; excellent opportunity to make winning start for Willie Mullins
runners.name: Hes On Fire
runners.spotlight: Went close over hurdles at Auteuil (2m2f, heavy) in November on third and final start in France; this looks an excellent opportunity to make a winning start for his top Irish trainer.

runners.comment: Kept on for 4th over 2m at Ayr on hurdle debut and the step up in trip looks a good move
runners.name: Johnny Moonshine
runners.spotlight: Point runner-up (3m, good to yielding) who has also shown promise when fourth in a bumper (here; 2m1f, soft) and on hurdle debut at Ayr (2m, soft); the step up in trip looks a good move and he can run well.

runners.comment: Two-time Irish point winner but tailed off on hurdle debut at Hereford in December
runners.name: Passing Diamond
runners.spotlight: Two Irish point wins; also showed promise in bumpers there; market check advised on stable debut but tailed off at 22-1 at Hereford (2m3f, good to soft) on sole run for Neil Mulholland; has to leave that well behind.

runners.comment: Two bumper wins last season but yet to transfer that promise to hurdles
runners.name: Swingingonthesteel
runners.spotlight: Point-to-point bumper winner (2m, soft) who landed two rules bumpers last season (1m7f/2m1f, good to soft); however, he's been unable to transfer that promise to hurdles on his two outings this term.

runners.comment: Won by 5l on debut in British maiden point; could give a good account
runners.name: The Dog Thief
runners.spotlight: 5l winner on debut in British maiden point (3m, good to soft) in December; his in-form trainer had a former pointer make a winning hurdle debut at Southwell recently; could give a good account on first rules start.

runners.comment: Signs of ability but will be of greater interest when qualified for handicaps after this
runners.name: Wherearethejudges
runners.spotlight: Has displayed signs of ability but tailed off at Ayr last time and he'll be of greater interest when qualified for handicaps after this.

runners.comment: Point winner who made fairly encouraging hurdle debut before a lesser run last time
runners.name: Rosa Diaz
runners.spotlight: Won Irish mares' maiden point (3m, yielding) on debut in November 2024; fairly encouraging hurdle debut when fifth at Ludlow (2m5f, good to soft) in December 2025; a lesser run followed at Sedgefield (2m4f, good to soft) but she's an each-way contender if back on song this afternoon.

14:35.race_name: Book Your Raceday Hospitality Now Handicap Chase (Challenger Staying Chase Series Qualifier) (GBB)

runners.comment: Ran well in third on last month's reappearance at Windsor and he's entitled to respect
runners.name: Saint Davy
runners.spotlight: Having ended last season in the doldrums he returned to form when third of five in first-time cheekpieces (retained) on last month's reappearance at Windsor (3m, soft); he goes well fresh so it remains to be seen if he'll improve for that latest outing, but he's respected nevertheless.

runners.comment: Promising fourth on reappearance here in November but two lesser performances since
runners.name: Westerninthepark
runners.spotlight: Promising fourth on reappearance here (3m2f, good to soft) in November and now 4lb lower; however, soundly beaten in Becher Chase next time and pulled up at Windsor (2m6f, soft) recently; has to get back on track.

runners.comment: Promising second on chase debut at Haydock and could build on that now back up in trip
runners.name: Ayiko
runners.spotlight: Bumper and maiden hurdle (3m, soft) winner who ran well when 2l second of three finishers in beginners' chase at Haydock (2m4f, soft) in December on first run over fences; could build on that now back up in trip; firmly in calculations.

runners.comment: Tailed off at Market Rasen last time but won here in November and he's not written off
runners.name: Sound And Fury
runners.spotlight: Took chase record to 3-6 when winning here (3m2f, good to soft) in November on reappearance; has also won on soft; lost a shoe and bled from the nose when sixth of 16 at Cheltenham next time; no obvious excuses when tailed off at Market Rasen last time but shouldn't be written off now back here.

runners.breeder: S C E A Ecurie La Grugerie Et Al
runners.comment: Ran well for long way over 3m4f at Windsor last time; could go well now back down in trip
runners.name: Hudson De Grugy
runners.spotlight: Returned to form with 18-1 win at Wetherby (3m, soft) two starts ago; tailed off at Windsor (3m4f, soft) since but he was still bang there jumping four out and could have a big part to play now back down in trip.

runners.comment: There's a suspicion he's regressive but he's not discounted in view of a dangerous mark
runners.name: President Scottie
runners.spotlight: Soundly beaten in the Borders National (4m, soft) and over hurdles at Ayr (3m, soft) on his last two starts; however, prior to those he was a respectable fourth on his reappearance over fences at Ayr (3m, soft) and is now 6lb lower; not discounted in view of that dangerous mark.

runners.comment: Made it 4 wins from last 5 starts when scoring easily at Sedgefield in December; up 9l
runners.name: Upfordebate
runners.spotlight: Made it four wins from his last five starts, and took his form to a new level, when winning easily in first-time cheekpieces (retained) at Sedgefield (3m2f, soft) in December last time; 9lb higher in a better race today but he's clearly thriving and may well play another leading role.

15:05.race_name: Carlisle Conditional Jockeys' Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle

runners.comment: Won point bumper; feeling his way over hurdles, close 4th latest (2m4f); can do better
runners.name: Scairp Dubh
runners.spotlight: Won point bumper last March; has been feeling his way over hurdles for new yard and while a handicap debut at Catterick was just mildly encouraging, he fared better when a close fourth in a big field at Newcastle (2m4f, good to soft) last month; can do better again; thereabouts.

runners.comment: Early promise at different levels; modest form now, in 2m/2m4f handicaps the last twice
runners.name: Tech That
runners.spotlight: Early promise in different spheres in 2024; lightly raced and has not shown much since, the return to 2m4f, in his second handicap, not obviously helpful at Uttoxeter recently; cheekpieces now fitted; much more needed.

runners.comment: Three Flat wins but 0-11 over hurdles and was a weak finisher upped to 2m4f latest
runners.name: Wind Your Neck In
runners.spotlight: Three Flat wins but 0-11 over hurdles and although he's weighted to win a race he didn't shine when upped to 2m4f at Market Rasen (good to soft; favourite) last time out; has plenty to prove with this stiff test.

runners.comment: Some promise at 2m4f; tough task on comeback from absence; hard to weigh up at present
runners.name: Upthereforthinking
runners.spotlight: Bits of form at up to 2m4f but he had a serious chunk of time off the track and although his December return, on tough terms in a seller, was inconclusive, it's hard to know what he's capable of now; first-time visor replaces cheekpieces.

runners.comment: Clear promise in course bumper; can improve on hurdle form now handicapping
runners.name: Knockeranna Rose
runners.spotlight: Little to show for his three runs in novice and maiden hurdles but there was clear evidence of ability in a course bumper (good) in October and an improved showing on his handicap debut is very much on the cards.

runners.comment: Some bumper ability; goes handicapping at an ordinary level; has another headgear switch
runners.name: Perfectot
runners.spotlight: Not disgraced in mares' bumpers but big prices and has finished remote in three hurdle runs; may fare better now handicapping at a realistic level but another headgear switch (cheekpieces replace a hood) raises a doubt.

runners.comment: Quite useful Irish point form; well held in 3 runs after 2 years off; better chance here
runners.name: Fine As Wine
runners.spotlight: Had some quite useful Irish point form in this context in 2023, only just failing in a race that worked out well; later had two years off the track; weak in the market and well held in three qualifying hurdle runs but this low-key start to her handicap career makes her worth a look.

runners.comment: Made it 2-2 over hurdles for new yard when winning over 2m4f latest; no hood this time
runners.name: Parish Star
runners.spotlight: Very ordinary handicap form in 2024 but she's come into her own for new yard, getting up near the line at Newcastle and quite impressive at Southwell (both about 2m4f; heavy and good to soft) 14 days ago; hooded each time but not today; back up 8lb but this stiff test can suit; respected.

runners.comment: Little to show for efforts in bumpers/over hurdles; this will be more his level
runners.name: Do Ye Wanna
runners.spotlight: Friendless in the market for all starts in bumpers and over hurdles, pulling up twice in last four attempts; this will be more his level but others have much more obvious claims.

runners.comment: Flat winner at 1m2f; not yet found level over hurdles, adrift on handicap debut latest
runners.name: Junkyard Dog
runners.owner: A Sinclair David Carroll & G Gibson
runners.spotlight: Won 1m2f handicap at Navan (RPR 75) last spring but he hasn't found his level over hurdles as yet, failing to pick up when 28-1 and finishing remote on handicap debut at Newcastle (2m4f, good to soft; Scairp Dubh fourth) last month; has plenty of work to do.

runners.comment: Two Flat wins but has shown very little in that code or over hurdles since spring 2024
runners.name: Gold Ring
runners.spotlight: Two Flat wins, the latest at 2m in 2023, but he's shown very little in a handful of starts on the Flat and over hurdles since spring 2024.

runners.breeder: S C E A Des Terrains DAvilly Saint Leon
runners.comment: Much higher in weights when close up over C&D last April but hard to fancy on recent form
runners.name: Liloo dOres
runners.spotlight: Maiden who is out of the weights and can hardly appeal on recent efforts but she did at least finish close up over C&D last April and has dropped a long way in the weights since; visor added (often wears cheekpieces).

runners.comment: Quite useful on Flat; Hexham winner (2m, heavy) in December; interesting on handicap debut
runners.name: Azahara Palace
runners.spotlight: Quite useful at up to 1m4f on the Flat for Hughie Morrison; got off the mark over hurdles in a mares' novice at Hexham (2m, heavy) in December but beaten 10l in similar event at Catterick last time (1m7f, good); quite interesting back on a stiff track on handicap debut.

runners.comment: In good form on last two starts, winning a maiden then 2nd in  Ayr handicap; contender
runners.name: Hes Bresilian
runners.owner: Fine Claret Racing & T S Ingham
runners.spotlight: Got off the mark when winning a maiden hurdle at Newcastle (2m1f, good to soft) in December  and ran another sound race when second in an Ayr handicap (2m, heavy) since; progressive and a contender.

runners.comment: Progressed since wind op with two handicap wins and a good 5th at Newbury; contender
runners.name: Soldiers Leap
runners.spotlight: Has progressed since wind surgery early last year, winning handicaps at Stratford (2m2f, good to soft) and Uttoxeter before decent fifth at Newbury (2m, good to soft) latest; 10lb higher than last winning mark but solid chance.

runners.comment: Sedgefield maiden hurdle winner in May and good 2nd here next time; not so good recently
runners.name: Celestial Reign
runners.spotlight: Won a maiden hurdle over 2m4f at Sedgefield in May (good); good second over this C&D (good to soft) next time but mainly disappointing since; others stronger.

runners.comment: Easy winner off 12lb lower in April but well beaten both runs since; a bit to prove
runners.name: Rock Hurley
runners.spotlight: Easy winner off a 12lb lower mark at Bangor (2m3f, good to soft; form sound) in April; well below that form in both starts since and has a bit to prove at present.

runners.comment: Two from two since visored, latest by 13l; up 9lb but should go well again
runners.name: Vampire Slayer
runners.spotlight: Two from two since visor went on, winning at Catterick (1m7f, soft) and Sedgefield (2m1f, good to soft; won by 13l); put up 9lb for last win but should be competitive again.

runners.comment: Six-time hurdle winner, latest in December 2023; pulled up last time; others appeal more
runners.name: Russian Virtue
runners.spotlight: Has won six times over hurdles, the latest a two-runner affair over C&D (good to soft) in December 2023; a couple of fair runs for this yard last year but pulled up when last seen out in January (reportedly never travelling); others appeal more.

runners.comment: 1-19 over hurdles; close 2nd at Newton Abbot in September; well beaten over C&D since
runners.name: Book Of Secrets
runners.spotlight: Has won only one of his 19 starts over hurdles, a Market Rasen maiden in August 2023 (2m, good to soft); fair second at Newton Abbot in September (2m1f, good to soft) but well beaten over C&D last twice.

runners.comment: Four AW Flat wins but 1-19 over hurdles; good 2nd in November and chance on that run
runners.name: Swinging London
runners.spotlight: Has won four times on the AW but sole jumps win was in a maiden hurdle at Fakenham in February 2022 (2m, soft); has a chance on his Leicester second (1m7f, soft) in November but a bit disappointing since.

runners.comment: Veteran who won twice last year, the second over C&D; now 5lb higher in a stronger race
runners.name: Fostered Phil
runners.spotlight: Veteran who won twice in 2025, the second by 7l over C&D (soft) in December; now 5lb higher in a stronger race.

runners.comment: Triple C&D winner but hasn't been in top form this season and others make more appeal
runners.name: Lady Babs
runners.spotlight: Veteran mare who has won seven races, three of them over C&D, but hasn't been in the best of form this season and others appeal more.

runners.comment: Five-time Flat winner; consistent over hurdles but has a bit to find with He's Bresilian
runners.name: Two Auld Pals
runners.spotlight: Five-time Flat winner who has a consistent profile over hurdles; handles soft ground but has a bit to find with He's Bresilian on last month's Ayr form.

runners.comment: Ex-Irish; 33-1 Ayr winner in November but hasn't run as well since (over 3m last time)
runners.name: Dees Getaway
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish; 33-1 winner at Ayr (2m, soft; tongue-tie refitted) in November on second run for present yard but she hasn't run as well since, last time when stepped up to 3m; others look stronger.

runners.comment: Maiden hurdle win for Stuart Crawford but hasn't run as well for new yard; on a good mark
runners.name: Interchangeable
runners.spotlight: Won Navan maiden hurdle for Stuart Crawford in December 2024 (2m3f, good to yielding); hasn't run up to his best in three starts for present yard but is down to a good mark.

16:05.race_name: Watch Racing TV Now Handicap Chase (Go North Monet's Garden Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Won at Newcastle in December and this course winner remains on a handy mark
runners.name: Trac
runners.spotlight: Returned to form to win in first-time blinkers (retained) at Newcastle (2m4f, good to soft) in December; back up 5lb he remains 2lb lower than when scoring here (2m, heavy) in April 2024 and he's one to consider.

runners.comment: Two wins at Cartmel in 2024 but below that level in 2025; first outing since last August
runners.name: Cuzco Du Mathan
runners.spotlight: Two wins at Cartmel (2m1f, soft/heavy) in 2024 and he's below his last winning mark; however, he wasn't at the same level on his four starts in 2025 and this is his first run since last August; others appeal more.

runners.comment: Below par at Hexham in October but a break may have helped and he can go well fresh
runners.name: Sean Og
runners.spotlight: Won at Cartmel (2m5f, soft) last June and runner-up at Perth (3m, good) in September; below par at Hexham in October when last seen but a break may have helped and he can go well fresh; could be a contender on his return.

runners.comment: Tailed off on handicap hurdle debut but this point runner-up could be suited by chasing
runners.name: Canunclecani
runners.spotlight: Tailed off on recent handicap hurdle debut at Ayr (3m, soft) and takes on seasoned chasers on this first runs over fences; however, his most promising runs in novice hurdles came here and this point runner-up could be suited by the switch to chasing; interesting.

runners.comment: Very useful for Henry de Bromhead in his prime but pulled up on all four runs last year
runners.name: Baptism Of Fire
runners.spotlight: Very useful for Henry de Bromhead in his prime but pulled up on all four runs since returning from long layoff for new yard last February.

runners.comment: Course winner who got back on the scoresheet at Sedgefield latest; on the shortlist up 4lb
runners.name: Largy Train
runners.spotlight: Completed hat-trick when winning here (2m5f, soft) in March 2024; lightly raced since and he got back on the scoresheet at Sedgefield (2m3f, good to soft) three weeks ago; he can give another good account up 4lb.

runners.comment: 2m3f win at Wetherby then travelled well when third over 3m1f at Catterick; lots to like
runners.name: Wolfburg
runners.spotlight: Won in fine style at Wetherby (2m3f, soft) on Boxing Day and ran another big race when third at Catterick (3m1f, soft) last month, when he travelled well but was outstayed; lots to like now back down in distance.

runners.comment: Something to prove over fences but cheekpieces may help and on a handy mark on hurdle form
runners.name: Streamsforth Lad
runners.spotlight: 15-race maiden who was pulled up on chase debut last February and unseated mid-race when back over fences two months ago; he has something to prove in this sphere but perhaps the first-time cheekpieces will help and he's on a handy mark on his November hurdle form; possible contender.

runners.comment: Made it 0-18 when below par at Market Rasen last time but he was in good heart previously
runners.name: Hawkseye View
runners.spotlight: Point winner who made it 0-18 under rules when below par at Market Rasen in Boxing Day, when the tongue-tie was left off and cheekpieces were applied (same today); however, he was in good heart prior to last time and might not be far away if bouncing back to form.

runners.comment: Very lightly 7yo; struggled in handicap hurdles; 5lb wrong at the weights on chase debut
runners.name: Westerdale
runners.spotlight: Very lightly raced 7yo who is one to watch in the betting on her chase debut; however, she struggled in her three handicap hurdles and is 5lb wrong at the weights this afternoon, so has plenty to prove.

16:35.race_name: Next Raceday Sunday 8th March Mares' Handicap Hurdle

runners.comment: The return to a right-handed track is a likely plus and she's high on the list
runners.name: Keppel Queen
runners.spotlight: Won a maiden hurdle on stable debut at Warwick (2m5f, good) in October and bounced back from a flop over fences when third of five in handicap hurdle at Plumpton (3m1f, soft) in January, when jumping to the right; the return to a right-handed track is a likely plus and she's high on the list.

runners.comment: Won at Ffos Las in November and she's better than she showed at Ludlow 12 days ago
runners.name: Hellfire Princess
runners.spotlight: 9yo who is lightly raced for her age and won at Ffos Las (2m6f, soft) in November on second run back from break; not seen to same effect at Ludlow (2m5f, soft) 12 days ago but she's better than that; not ruled out.

runners.comment: Course novice winner who was third at Haydock in December and could build on that effort
runners.name: Vroomoz Eile
runners.spotlight: Won novice hurdle here (2m3f, soft) last February and she returned to form when third of seven at Haydock (3m, good to soft) in December following a break; could build on that latest effort and she's a possible player.

runners.comment: Only sixth at Taunton when upped to 3m but could better that when back on soft ground
runners.name: Smile Back
runners.spotlight: Course bumper winner (soft) who was runner-up at Leicester (2m4f, soft) towards the end of last year in her first two handicaps; only sixth when upped in trip at Taunton (3m, good to soft) last month but she could better that latest run when back on soft ground, on which she's shown her best form.
